verses.en: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
verses.sm: Atua, E matuā matautia oE i au galuega.

verses.en: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
verses.sm: O lou malosi tele e faatagā vivii atu ai ia te oe o E ua ita ia te oe.

verses.en: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
verses.sm: E ifo atu lava ja te oe le lalolagi uma; latou ie fai pesega ia te oe, latou te fai pesega i lou suafa. Sela.

verses.en: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.
verses.sm: O mai ia, ia outou matamata i galuega a le Atua; e matautia ia i mea na na faia i le fanau a tagata. Na ia liua le sami ma laueleele matutu;

verses.en: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.
verses.sm: na latou sopoia atu le vaitafe i o latou vae; na tatou fiafia ia te ia i lea mea;

verses.en: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
verses.sm: e pule ia e faavavau i lona lava malosi; ua matua silasila atu ona fofoga i nuu ese; o e fouvale aua ne“ faamauluga i latou.

verses.en: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.sm: Sela. Le nuu E, ia outou faafetai atu i lo tatou Atua; ia logona mai le leo o lona viiga.

verses.en: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
verses.sm: O le na tuuina mai le ola i totonu ia i tatou, na te le tuuna i tatou ia mapepeva ai O tatou vae.

verses.en: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
verses.sm: Aua na 2 suesueina i matou, le Atua E; na e tofotofoina i matou, e pei o le ario ona tofotofoina.

verses.en: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
verses.sm: Na e aumaia i matou i le upega; na e tuuina mai mea mamafa i o matou tua.

verses.en: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
verses.sm: Na e faatietie tagata i o matou ulu; na matou savavali i le afi ma le vai;

verses.en: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
verses.sm: a ua e tafita‘iina mai i matou i le nuu lafulemu. Ou te alu atu i lou fale ma taulaga mu; ou te avatua ja te oe mea na Ou tauto ai.

verses.en: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
verses.sm: 15 16 17 18 19 SALAMO 66, O mea ia na ou fai atu ai i oʻu laugutu,

verses.en: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
verses.sm: na ou tautala atu ai i loʻu gutu i loʻu puapuaga. Ou te avatua ia te oe taulaga mu i mea pepeti,

verses.en: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
verses.sm: atoa ma mea manogi; Ou te saunia mamoe poa, o povi poa, atoa ma ‘oti poa. Sela. Outou uma o e matatau i le Atua, o mai ia,

verses.en: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
verses.sm: ina faalogologo mai, ona ou taʻu atu ai lea o mea na na faia mo loʻu agaga. Na ou alaga atu ia te ia i loʻu gutu,

verses.en: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
verses.sm: ua yua foi o ia e loʻu laulaufaiva. Ana ou manatu i se amio leaga i lo‘u loto,

verses.en: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
verses.sm: po ua le faafofoga mai le Alii ia te au;

verses.en: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
verses.sm: a e peitai ua faafofogaina mai aʻu e le Atua; ua ia liliu mai i le leo o laʻu tatalo.

verses.en: Blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
verses.sm: Ia faafetaia le Atua, ua na le liliueseina la‘u tatalo, po o lona alofa ia te au.
